name: Crunchtime Ops Execution (formerly Zenput)
oneLiner: Operations execution software for multi-unit restaurants, part of the Crunchtime platform: digital checklists, audits, food safety and temperature monitoring, corrective actions and rollout tracking across locations. Renamed from Zenput in February 2026.
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant brands and franchise systems (also convenience stores and grocers) that need every location to follow the same procedures, audits and food safety checks.

updates.text: Zenput was renamed Crunchtime Ops Execution to bring it fully into the Crunchtime suite (Crunchtime acquired Zenput in 2022).
Crunchtime introduced new AI capabilities across inventory, operations execution and analytics.

features: Digital checklists and task management pushed to every store
Brand standards audits and inspections, including field visits
Food safety logs with automated temperature monitoring
Corrective action workflows that follow up on failed items
Rollout tracking for new initiatives across locations
Mobile-first app for store teams and area managers
Connects with Crunchtime inventory, labor and learning products

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Crunchtime does not publish prices.

notes: Zenput is now Crunchtime Ops Execution (blog post dated Feb 9, 2026); zenput.com still resolves and carries a 'Zenput is now Crunchtime Ops Execution' banner. Use the new name and the crunchtime.com link. Dropped from the current review: '50,000 locations in 40+ countries' (Crunchtime/Zenput now claims 125,000+ locations in 100+ countries for the Crunchtime platform), G2/Capterra 4.7/5 (G2 currently shows about 4.6 from 142 reviews), the 20% audit-score, 24% compliance and 5 hours/week stats (unverified), and named customers Taco Bell franchisee Tacala, Gong cha and P.F. Chang's (not re-verified). Crunchtime published a TravelCenters of America case study (June 2025; 54% better task performance, vendor-reported). Temperature monitoring and food labeling are reported as add-ons; not re-verified.
